name: What factors determine if my tankless water heater should be repaired or replaced?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine if my tankless water heater should be repaired or replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace a tankless water heater depends on several factors: the age of the unit, the cost of the repair versus a new unit, and the extent of the damage. If your unit is older than 10-15 years, frequently breaking down, or the repair cost exceeds 50% of a new unit's price, replacement might be more economical. We'll assess the condition of your existing unit and provide an honest recommendation, helping you weigh the long-term benefits and costs of each option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider age, repair cost vs. new unit price, and damage extent. If old, frequently breaking down, or repair cost is high, replacement might be better.
